questions.prompt: What is the plant cell wall mostly made of?
questions.explanation: The plant cell wall is mostly made of cellulose, a strong carbohydrate that forms a rigid shell.
questions.misconception: The wall is not protein or DNA - it is a structural carbohydrate, like a very strong building material.

questions.prompt: What is one main job of the cell wall?
options: To support and protect the cell and give it shape
questions.explanation: The cell wall is a rigid shell that gives plant cells support, protection, and their fixed shape.
questions.misconception: Storing DNA is the nucleus and making protein is the ribosome - the wall is all about structure.

questions.prompt: Which cells have a cell wall?
options: Plant cells, fungi, and many bacteria
questions.explanation: Plant cells, fungi, and many bacteria have cell walls. Animal cells do not - they are supported by membranes and other structures.
questions.misconception: Animal cells do not have a cell wall, which is why animal cells can move and change shape more freely.

questions.prompt: Even though a plant has a cell wall, what still controls what enters the cell?
options: The cell membrane inside the wall
questions.explanation: The cell membrane still lies inside the wall and controls what enters and leaves the cell; the wall is mainly for support.
questions.misconception: The wall is like a gatehouse? No - it is mostly a support shell; the membrane is still the controller of entry and exit.
